framing.lineOfInquiry: Nisha Kapoor (P00335) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE007
framing.alternate: Nisha Kapoor (P00335) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Nisha Kapoor's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate
